tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap copied all 7 scenario .xaml/.cs verbatim and mass-replaced Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml; the agent only had to edit copies in place. Final build succeeded with 0 errors.
session-log line 7264/7448/7570: '[PASS] dotnet build succeeded (1090 warning(s), 0 WUI analyzer warning(s))' — gave the agent a clean go/no-go signal.

tools_problematic.problem: Piping a long-running dotnet build through a Where-Object filter made the command appear to hang for 8+ minutes; the agent had to stop_powershell and re-run unfiltered.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log lines 7016-7052: shellId 15 'still running' repeated, then stopped and re-run without the filter.

tool_limitations.limitation: Copies every *.cs verbatim, including legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs, which collides with the SDK-style project's auto-generated assembly attributes (GenerateAssemblyInfo=true by default).
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Skip AssemblyInfo.cs files at copy time (same rationale as the existing bin/obj skip), since the SDK regenerates them.

errors_encountered.error: CS0579: Duplicate 'System.Reflection.AssemblyCompanyAttribute' (and AssemblyConfiguration/FileVersion/Product/Title/Version) attribute — 6 errors, build failed
errors_encountered.root_cause: The UWP source's Tasks\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs (with [assembly: AssemblyTitle], [assembly: AssemblyVersion], etc.) was copied into the migrated tree. SDK-style projects auto-generate the same attributes (GenerateAssemblyInfo defaults to true), so both definitions collide.
errors_encountered.fix: Agent added <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo> to the csproj PropertyGroup. Cleaner/more general fix: don't copy legacy AssemblyInfo.cs at all (let the SDK generate it).

dev_agent_struggles.where: First full build of the migrated project
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build failed with 6x CS0579 duplicate-attribute errors
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs copied from UWP source duplicates SDK auto-generated assembly attributes
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 skipping AssemblyInfo.cs at copy time, plus a CS0579 entry in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md build-error first-aid section.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: dotnet build piped through a Where-Object match filter appeared to hang for ~8 minutes
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Streaming a long build through a line-filter delayed/blocked visible completion
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Stopped the shell and re-ran dotnet build unfiltered
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Guidance to run dotnet build unfiltered (or capture to a file then grep) rather than piping a live build through Where-Object.

env_issues.issue: Screenshots captured blank (PrintWindow cannot grab WinUI 3 DirectComposition; no interactive desktop) and the UWP CoreWindow UIA tree was not externally enumerable.
env_issues.workaround: Fidelity verified via the WinUI 3 UIA tree instead. This is an eval-environment limitation, not a migration defect.
